notes.title: Down The Hole - Update 5
notes.notes:
[h1]Quality of Life![/h1]
Down The Hole has some small yet useful changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36961949/c305b9d4b064ece144377c7f48b074adc8085b65.png[/img]

- Loading workshop levels now load faster.
- Goo turret animations now play.
- Core code fixes and optimizations.
- Flamethrowers now have indicator lights.
- Mines now respawn.
- Model optimizations.

notes.title: Down The Hole - Update 4
notes.notes:
[h1]Chapter 5 Now Available![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36961949/655040c200d151e794c9c4fdad5d965076026bd7.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
- Duplicate workshop next level names not loading correctly
- Fixed user levels not saving due to special chars
- Turrets no longer will have a NULL rotation vector
- Community levels saves to the SteamCloud

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
- Goo Turrets have been optimized
- Disabled Discord API

[h2]Added:[/h2]
- Level progress now saves with Steam
- New enemy type: mines
- Two new outfits

notes.title: Down The Hole - Update 3
notes.notes:
[h1]Whats New:[/h1]

[h1]Chapter 4 Now Available![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36961949/00fcfaeb82e29ecae96bbd660fe9c1aef8feeb35.jpg[/img]

[h2]Master volume setting added for more control over the audio in the game![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36961949/ce5495c14e908ddbb22f54321c501417d74e98eb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
- Editor input fields now max at 32 characters.
- Editor workshop upload and update description now supports 32 lines of text.
- Editor progress UI overlays correctly.
- Fixed toggle music not saving correctly.
- Multiple players spawning when clicking the Start Game button more than once.
- Player spawning when loading the level editor, caused multiple player spawning.
- Player collider scaled down so projectiles hit correctly

[h1]Added:[/h1]
- Projectiles now get removed on level change.
- Chapter 4.
- New enemy type: Goo Turret.
- Master audio slider in the settings menu.
- Custom shader for better optimization.
- Audio optimization.
- New SFXs.
- Selecting a chapter and going back will now take you to the chapter select instead of the menu.
- Once loaded into a story level, going back will take you to chapter select.
- Loading user levels and going back will take you to the user levels list.
- User levels play a different soundtrack from the menu.

notes.title: Down The Hole - Update 2
notes.notes:

Chapter 3
Discord API
New outfits
New achievement

Death counter

UI overlaps
Outfits not loading
Improved Steam API calls
Improved text scale for some levels

notes.title: Down The Hole - Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Whats new:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36961949/0f1fffee2eb1ef90722cf5883cca3a2b66964476.gif[/img]

[h2]Added:[/h2]
UI showing the user level along with the description [As seen above]
Workshop button.
New Steam achievement.
New Outfit.
After completing a user level that does not have a next level link, you will be taken back to the user levels list and not the menu.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
Official levels are preloaded for faster load times.
Any and all player outfits no longer have collision.
Steam API calls optimized.
Editor UI displaying under other UI elements
